info.title: CSV Data Retrieval API
info.description: An API service for retrieving the contents of a CSV file from a specified path.

get.summary: Retrieve CSV content from a specified file path

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: The full path to the CSV file to retrieve.

400.description: Bad request — missing or invalid file path.

404.description: CSV file not found at the specified path.

500.description: Internal server error while processing the CSV file.
